title: Single-step purification by heat shock
author: Hossein Tarrahimofrad
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgbsjsne

steps.title: Cultivate and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Cultivate cells in 50 mL at 37 °C overnight, then collect and resuspend them.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 3500 x g for 30 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in 4 mL lysis buffer (50 mM NaH2PO4, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM Imidazole, and 0.05% volume Tween 20 at pH 7).

steps.title: Sonicate the mixture
steps.instruction: Perform sonication on the mixture at 4 °C using specific pulse cycles.

steps.title: Clarify and heat-treat extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the crude extracts and apply heat shock to the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge crude extracts at 9000 x g at 4 °C.
Heat-treat the resulting supernatant in a hot water bath at 90 °C for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Separate insoluble material
steps.instruction: Remove precipitated proteins via centrifugation and analyze the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C to separate insoluble material.
Analyze the supernatant containing the enzyme on a 12% SDS–polyacrylamide gel.

steps.title: Dialyze purified fractions
steps.instruction: Dialyze the purified elution fractions overnight.

substeps.instruction: Perform dialysis at 4 °C using 50 mM buffer at pH 7.
